name: overhead-squat.html
instructions:
1. Unrack the bar on your back with a snatch grip and push press it overhead to get into position.
2. Once the bar is in position overhead, take a deep breath and sit straight down by simultaneously pushing the hips back and bending the knees.
3. Once your thighs reach parallel with the floor, begin to reverse the movement.
4. Keep your abs braced and drive your feet through the floor.
5. Finish the lift by exhaling as you fully extend the hips and knees.
